نجتل (form VIII)
# نَجْتَلِ (najtali) /nad͡ʒ.ta.li/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِجْتَلَى (ijtalā)
# نُجْتَلَ (nujtala) /nud͡ʒ.ta.la/: first-person plural non-past passive jussive of اِجْتَلَى (ijtalā)
